scope_note: Teaching text explains reaction families and evidence limits; it is not an experimental SOP.
scope_note_zh: 教学文字用于解释反应家族和证据边界，不构成可直接执行的实验操作规程。

IUPAC_GLYCOSIDES.title: IUPAC Nomenclature of Carbohydrates: glycosides and glycosyl compounds

P005.title: Total synthesis of agalloside by 5-O-glycosylation of flavan

P009.title: Directed evolution of a plant glycosyltransferase

P010.title: Regio-selectivity control of a flavonoid O-glycosyltransferase

P013.title: Glycosylation of hesperetin by plant cell cultures

P014.title: Molecular and enzymatic basis of citrus rhamnosyltransferases

default.principle: A reverse reaction SMARTS matched the product and generated precursor graphs, but the available metadata does not support a more specific reaction-family assignment.
default.principle_zh: 逆反应 SMARTS 与产物匹配并生成了前体分子图，但现有元数据不足以给出更具体的反应家族判定。
typical_conditions: No conditions may be inferred from connectivity alone.
typical_conditions_zh: 不能仅根据连接关系推断反应条件。
risk_notes: Treat the step as a computational hypothesis until a chemist reviews the atom mapping, reagents, selectivity, and substrate scope.
risk_notes_zh: 在化学人员审查原子映射、试剂、选择性和底物范围前，仅将该步骤视为计算假设。
default.evidence_boundary: Template application demonstrates a graph transformation, not experimental feasibility or yield.
default.evidence_boundary_zh: 模板应用只证明分子图变换可被编码，不证明实验可行性或收率。

0.0 Unrecognized.principle: The upstream template set explicitly marks this transformation as unrecognized; the platform therefore does not invent a named reaction.
0.0 Unrecognized.principle_zh: 上游模板库明确将该变换标记为未识别；平台不会据此臆造命名反应。
typical_conditions: Require retrieval of the source reaction record before condition assignment.
typical_conditions_zh: 必须回查源反应记录后才能指定条件。
risk_notes: Reaction type, chemoselectivity, and conditions all require expert review.
risk_notes_zh: 反应类型、化学选择性和条件均需专家复核。
0.0 Unrecognized.evidence_boundary: A valid template match is not a reaction classification.
0.0 Unrecognized.evidence_boundary_zh: 有效的模板匹配并不等于完成了反应分类。

o_glycoside_cleavage.principle: Disconnect the bond between a phenolic oxygen and the anomeric carbon into an aglycone and a sugar-side precursor; the forward direction is O-glycoside formation.
o_glycoside_cleavage.principle_zh: 将酚氧与异头碳之间的键拆分为苷元和糖侧前体；正向对应 O-糖苷形成。
typical_conditions: Activated glycosyl donor under a validated promoter system
or a compatible glycosyltransferase/whole-cell system
typical_conditions_zh: 经验证的促进体系配合活化糖基供体
或相容的糖基转移酶/全细胞体系
risk_notes: Regioselectivity, anomeric selectivity, protecting groups, and donor activation are not fixed by the generic disconnection.
risk_notes_zh: 通用断键并未确定区域选择性、异头选择性、保护基策略或供体活化方式。
o_glycoside_cleavage.evidence_boundary: A free sugar leaf is a connectivity surrogate unless an activated donor and forward conditions are independently supported.
o_glycoside_cleavage.evidence_boundary_zh: 若没有独立证据支持活化供体和正向条件，游离糖叶节点只属于连接性替代物。

glycosylation.principle: Form a glycosidic linkage between a glycosyl residue and an acceptor; O-, C-, N-, and S-linked products must be distinguished.
glycosylation.principle_zh: 在糖基残基与受体之间形成糖苷连接；必须区分 O、C、N 和 S 连接类型。
typical_conditions: Chemical donor activation or enzyme-catalysed transfer, selected for the encoded linkage
typical_conditions_zh: 依据目标连接类型选择化学供体活化或酶催化转移
risk_notes: Anomeric configuration and acceptor-site selectivity are major unresolved variables.
risk_notes_zh: 异头构型和受体位点选择性是主要未决变量。
glycosylation.evidence_boundary: Family-level guidance does not establish a particular donor, catalyst, or substrate scope.
glycosylation.evidence_boundary_zh: 家族级说明不能证明某个具体供体、催化剂或底物适用范围。

o_glycosylation.principle: Form an O-glycosidic bond at a hydroxyl acceptor, commonly a phenolic oxygen in this project.
o_glycosylation.principle_zh: 在羟基受体上形成 O-糖苷键；本项目常见受体为酚氧。
typical_conditions: Activated donor/promoter or glycosyltransferase with site control
typical_conditions_zh: 活化供体/促进剂体系，或具有位点控制能力的糖基转移酶
risk_notes: Competing hydroxyl groups usually require enzymatic selectivity or a protection strategy.
risk_notes_zh: 存在多个竞争羟基时通常需要酶选择性或保护基策略。
o_glycosylation.evidence_boundary: The label identifies connectivity, not a validated forward protocol.
o_glycosylation.evidence_boundary_zh: 该标签只标识连接类型，不代表已验证正向工艺。

c_glycosylation.principle: Form a carbon-carbon linkage between the sugar anomeric carbon and the flavonoid scaffold rather than an O-glycosidic bond.
c_glycosylation.principle_zh: 在糖的异头碳与黄酮骨架之间形成碳—碳键，而不是 O-糖苷键。
typical_conditions: A substrate-specific C-glycosylation method with explicit regioselectivity evidence
typical_conditions_zh: 具有明确区域选择性证据、适用于具体底物的 C-糖基化方法
risk_notes: O-glycosylation conditions cannot be transferred automatically to a C-linked target.
risk_notes_zh: O-糖基化条件不能自动迁移到 C-连接目标。
c_glycosylation.evidence_boundary: IUPAC terminology defines the linkage; experimental feasibility remains record-specific.
c_glycosylation.evidence_boundary_zh: IUPAC 术语界定连接类型；实验可行性仍取决于具体反应记录。

activated_glycosyl_donor.principle: Represent the sugar-side precursor as an activated donor rather than as an unactivated free sugar.
activated_glycosyl_donor.principle_zh: 将糖侧前体表示为活化供体，而不是未活化的游离糖。
typical_conditions: Donor leaving group and promoter must be taken from a cited substrate-compatible method
typical_conditions_zh: 供体离去基和促进剂必须来自有引用且与底物相容的方法
risk_notes: Donor identity, protecting groups, and anomeric outcome are coupled design choices.
risk_notes_zh: 供体身份、保护基和异头结果是相互耦合的设计选择。
activated_glycosyl_donor.evidence_boundary: An abstract donor never counts as strict closure without independent identity and availability evidence.
activated_glycosyl_donor.evidence_boundary_zh: 抽象供体在没有独立身份和可得性证据时绝不能计为严格闭合。

whole_cell_glycosylation.principle: A living-cell system performs the net transfer while cellular metabolism supplies activated sugar donors.
whole_cell_glycosylation.principle_zh: 活细胞体系完成净糖基转移，活化糖供体由细胞代谢提供。
typical_conditions: The exact engineered cell line, expression construct, feeding substrate, and isolation workflow reported by the cited study
typical_conditions_zh: 必须使用文献所述的具体工程细胞系、表达构建、投料底物和分离流程
risk_notes: Cell culture, biosafety, product isolation, and scale-up are outside a simple reaction-template description.
risk_notes_zh: 细胞培养、生物安全、产物分离和放大不可能由简单反应模板完整描述。
whole_cell_glycosylation.evidence_boundary: An exact reported net transformation is not a generic chemical glycosylation method.
whole_cell_glycosylation.evidence_boundary_zh: 文献报道的特定净转化不等同于通用化学糖基化方法。

methylation.principle: Attach a methyl group to a molecular site; in flavonoid synthesis this commonly forms an O-methyl ether.
methylation.principle_zh: 在分子位点引入甲基；黄酮合成中常见结果是形成 O-甲醚。
typical_conditions: A substrate-compatible methyl source and base or catalytic system
typical_conditions_zh: 与底物相容的甲基源及碱或催化体系
risk_notes: Many traditional methylating reagents are toxic or strongly alkylating; the hard safety screen may exclude them.
risk_notes_zh: 许多传统甲基化试剂具有毒性或强烷基化性，可能被安全硬剪枝排除。
methylation.evidence_boundary: The family label does not establish regioselectivity among multiple hydroxyl groups.
methylation.evidence_boundary_zh: 家族标签不能证明多个羟基之间的区域选择性。

o_methylation.principle: Convert a phenolic oxygen into a methyl ether; retrosynthetically, disconnect the O-CH3 bond.
o_methylation.principle_zh: 将酚氧转化为甲醚；逆合成中断开 O—CH3 键。
typical_conditions: A chemoselective methylation method supported for the hydroxyl pattern
typical_conditions_zh: 对相应羟基排列有支持证据的化学选择性甲基化方法
risk_notes: A methyl-iodide surrogate is a graph device and is blocked by the current severe-toxicity policy.
risk_notes_zh: 碘甲烷替代物只是分子图工具，并被当前严重毒性策略阻断。
o_methylation.evidence_boundary: Connectivity does not establish a safe reagent choice or site selectivity.
o_methylation.evidence_boundary_zh: 连接关系不能证明安全的试剂选择或位点选择性。

o_demethylation.principle: Reveal a phenol by cleaving an aryl O-methyl bond.
o_demethylation.principle_zh: 通过断裂芳基 O—甲基键恢复酚羟基。
typical_conditions: A substrate-compatible ether-cleavage method selected after functional-group review
typical_conditions_zh: 在官能团审查后选择与底物相容的醚键断裂方法
risk_notes: Common cleavage systems may be corrosive or incompatible with glycosides and protecting groups.
risk_notes_zh: 常用断裂体系可能具有腐蚀性，或与糖苷和保护基不相容。
o_demethylation.evidence_boundary: The reverse template identifies the bond change only.

protection.principle: Temporarily mask a reactive group so that it does not react under a later operation.
protection.principle_zh: 暂时掩蔽活性官能团，使其在后续反应条件下不参与反应。
typical_conditions: Protecting group chosen for installation, stability, and orthogonal removal across the full route
typical_conditions_zh: 按整条路线的安装、稳定性和正交脱除要求选择保护基
risk_notes: Each protection adds steps and can change solubility, selectivity, and purification.
risk_notes_zh: 每次保护都会增加步骤，并可能改变溶解性、选择性和纯化难度。
protection.evidence_boundary: A generic protection template does not prove orthogonality in the proposed route.
protection.evidence_boundary_zh: 通用保护模板不能证明其在拟议路线中的正交性。

phenol_protection.principle: Mask one or more phenolic hydroxyl groups to control later chemo- or regioselectivity.
phenol_protection.principle_zh: 掩蔽一个或多个酚羟基，以控制后续化学选择性或区域选择性。
typical_conditions: A protection pattern validated against all other hydroxyl groups and later steps
typical_conditions_zh: 保护模式必须针对其他全部羟基和后续步骤进行验证
risk_notes: Over-protection and difficult selective deprotection are common route risks.
risk_notes_zh: 过度保护和难以选择性脱保护是常见路线风险。
phenol_protection.evidence_boundary: The template does not choose a unique protecting group or position.
phenol_protection.evidence_boundary_zh: 模板并未选择唯一保护基或位点。

deprotection.principle: Remove a temporary protecting group to restore the intended functional group.
deprotection.principle_zh: 去除临时保护基，恢复目标官能团。
typical_conditions: Conditions selected for orthogonality and substrate stability
typical_conditions_zh: 根据正交性和底物稳定性选择条件
risk_notes: Late-stage deprotection can damage glycosidic bonds or alter stereochemistry.
risk_notes_zh: 后期脱保护可能破坏糖苷键或影响立体化学。
deprotection.evidence_boundary: Compatibility must be checked for the complete protected intermediate.
deprotection.evidence_boundary_zh: 必须针对完整受保护中间体检查相容性。

phenol_deprotection.principle: Restore a phenolic hydroxyl group from a protected precursor.
phenol_deprotection.principle_zh: 从受保护前体恢复酚羟基。
typical_conditions: Group-specific cleavage after checking glycoside and scaffold stability
typical_conditions_zh: 在检查糖苷键和骨架稳定性后采用保护基专一的断裂条件
risk_notes: Global and site-selective deprotection are not interchangeable.
risk_notes_zh: 全局脱保护与位点选择性脱保护不能互换。
phenol_deprotection.evidence_boundary: The reaction family alone does not establish selectivity.
phenol_deprotection.evidence_boundary_zh: 仅凭反应家族不能证明选择性。

oxidation.principle: Increase oxidation state, commonly corresponding in organic structures to oxygen gain and/or hydrogen loss.
oxidation.principle_zh: 提高氧化态；在有机结构中常表现为增氧和/或脱氢。
typical_conditions: Oxidant and medium selected for the required chemoselectivity
typical_conditions_zh: 根据所需化学选择性选择氧化剂和介质
risk_notes: Over-oxidation and oxidation of phenols or sugars require explicit control.
risk_notes_zh: 必须明确控制过度氧化以及酚或糖部分的氧化。
oxidation.evidence_boundary: Oxidation is a broad class; reagent, site, and oxidation level remain record-specific.
oxidation.evidence_boundary_zh: 氧化是宽泛类别；试剂、位点和氧化程度仍取决于具体记录。

reduction.principle: Lower oxidation state; this is the reverse of the corresponding oxidation process.
reduction.principle_zh: 降低氧化态，是相应氧化过程的逆过程。
typical_conditions: Reducing system selected for functional-group and stereochemical compatibility
typical_conditions_zh: 根据官能团和立体化学相容性选择还原体系
risk_notes: Hydrogenation or hydride reagents can affect multiple unsaturated or carbonyl sites.
risk_notes_zh: 氢化或氢化物试剂可能影响多个不饱和位点或羰基。
reduction.evidence_boundary: The class does not define a reagent, selectivity, or stereochemical outcome.
reduction.evidence_boundary_zh: 该类别不定义具体试剂、选择性或立体化学结果。

cyclization.principle: Form a ring from a chain or open precursor by creating a new bond.
cyclization.principle_zh: 通过形成新键，使链状或开链前体生成环。
typical_conditions: Mechanism-specific acid, base, catalyst, thermal, or photochemical conditions
typical_conditions_zh: 依据机理选择酸、碱、催化、热或光化学条件
risk_notes: Ring size, competing closures, and stereochemistry must be assessed for the actual substrate.
risk_notes_zh: 必须针对实际底物评估环尺寸、竞争环化和立体化学。
cyclization.evidence_boundary: The generic label only states that a ring-forming bond change occurred.
cyclization.evidence_boundary_zh: 通用标签只说明发生了成环键变化。

flavonoid_cyclization.principle: Close an oxygen-containing ring or related ring system needed for a flavonoid scaffold.
flavonoid_cyclization.principle_zh: 闭合构建黄酮骨架所需的含氧环或相关环系。
typical_conditions: Substrate- and scaffold-specific cyclization conditions from a cited route
typical_conditions_zh: 采用有引用且适用于具体底物和骨架的环化条件
risk_notes: Substitution pattern controls which ring and regioisomer form.
risk_notes_zh: 取代模式决定形成的环及区域异构体。
flavonoid_cyclization.evidence_boundary: A scaffold-level label is insufficient to assign a named mechanism.
flavonoid_cyclization.evidence_boundary_zh: 骨架级标签不足以指定命名机理。

flavanone_synthesis.principle: Construct the flavanone C-ring, often from a chalcone-like precursor through intramolecular conjugate addition.
flavanone_synthesis.principle_zh: 构建二氢黄酮 C 环，常由查耳酮样前体经分子内共轭加成形成。
typical_conditions: A cited cyclization method compatible with the substitution and protection pattern
typical_conditions_zh: 采用与取代和保护模式相容的有引用环化方法
risk_notes: Stereocentre formation and chalcone/flavanone equilibrium require review.
risk_notes_zh: 需审查手性中心形成以及查耳酮/二氢黄酮平衡。
flavanone_synthesis.evidence_boundary: The family label does not determine stereoselectivity or yield.
flavanone_synthesis.evidence_boundary_zh: 家族标签不能确定立体选择性或收率。

flavanone_chalcone_opening.principle: Retrosynthetically open the flavanone heterocycle to a chalcone-like precursor.
flavanone_chalcone_opening.principle_zh: 逆合成中将二氢黄酮杂环打开为查耳酮样前体。
typical_conditions: Forward cyclization conditions must be validated on the substituted chalcone
typical_conditions_zh: 正向环化条件必须在相应取代查耳酮上验证
risk_notes: Current project SMARTS variants require atom-map-retention validation before promotion.
risk_notes_zh: 本项目当前 SMARTS 变体需通过原子映射保留验证后才能晋级。
flavanone_chalcone_opening.evidence_boundary: An inactive or audit-failing family template is not a product-search action.
flavanone_chalcone_opening.evidence_boundary_zh: 未激活或审计失败的家族模板不属于产品搜索动作。

chalcone_synthesis.principle: Construct an alpha,beta-unsaturated carbonyl linking two aromatic fragments, commonly through a condensation logic.
chalcone_synthesis.principle_zh: 构建连接两个芳香片段的 α,β-不饱和羰基，通常采用缩合逻辑。
typical_conditions: Aldehyde/ketone pairing and acid or base conditions supported for the hydroxyl/protection pattern
typical_conditions_zh: 针对羟基/保护模式有支持证据的醛酮组合及酸或碱条件
risk_notes: Self-condensation, E/Z geometry, and phenolic side reactions require control.
risk_notes_zh: 需控制自缩合、E/Z 构型和酚羟基副反应。
chalcone_synthesis.evidence_boundary: Condensation family assignment does not validate a particular substrate pair.
chalcone_synthesis.evidence_boundary_zh: 缩合家族判定不能验证某一具体底物对。

chalcone_aldol.principle: Join carbonyl partners through aldol addition followed by dehydration to an enone.
chalcone_aldol.principle_zh: 羰基组分先发生羟醛加成，再脱水形成烯酮。
typical_conditions: Substrate-compatible acid/base catalysis with protection and geometry control
typical_conditions_zh: 与底物相容、兼顾保护基和构型控制的酸/碱催化
risk_notes: Competing carbonyl and phenolic sites can reduce selectivity.
risk_notes_zh: 竞争性羰基和酚位点会降低选择性。
chalcone_aldol.evidence_boundary: The generic reverse disconnection is not a validated forward recipe.
chalcone_aldol.evidence_boundary_zh: 通用逆断键不是已验证的正向配方。

chalcone_retro_aldol.principle: Disconnect the enone framework into carbonyl-derived fragments corresponding to a forward aldol condensation.
chalcone_retro_aldol.principle_zh: 将烯酮骨架断开为对应正向羟醛缩合的羰基来源片段。
typical_conditions: Forward conditions must be selected from a substrate-matched record
typical_conditions_zh: 正向条件必须从与底物匹配的记录中选择
risk_notes: Project SMARTS must pass applicability and atom-map audits before use.
risk_notes_zh: 项目 SMARTS 必须通过适用性和原子映射审计后方可使用。
chalcone_retro_aldol.evidence_boundary: A desired reaction family can remain inactive when its encoded SMARTS is not validated.
chalcone_retro_aldol.evidence_boundary_zh: 即使是所需反应家族，其 SMARTS 未验证时也应保持未激活。

flavonoid_synthesis.principle: A broad corpus label for transformations that build or reorganize a flavonoid scaffold.
flavonoid_synthesis.principle_zh: 语料库中的宽泛标签，表示构建或重组黄酮骨架的变换。
typical_conditions: Retrieve the exact source record; no single condition set represents this class
typical_conditions_zh: 必须回查具体源记录；本类别不存在统一条件
risk_notes: Do not infer a named reaction from this broad label alone.
risk_notes_zh: 不得仅凭该宽泛标签推断命名反应。
flavonoid_synthesis.evidence_boundary: Corpus classification only; inspect the actual bond changes.
flavonoid_synthesis.evidence_boundary_zh: 仅为语料分类，必须检查实际键变化。

isoflavone_synthesis.principle: A broad label for forming or rearranging the isoflavone carbon skeleton.
isoflavone_synthesis.principle_zh: 表示形成或重排异黄酮碳骨架的宽泛标签。
typical_conditions: Use the exact cited transformation corresponding to the encoded bond changes
typical_conditions_zh: 采用与编码键变化相对应的具体有引用变换
risk_notes: Substitution pattern and migration selectivity are substrate-specific.
risk_notes_zh: 取代模式和迁移选择性具有底物特异性。
isoflavone_synthesis.evidence_boundary: The class name does not identify a unique mechanism.
isoflavone_synthesis.evidence_boundary_zh: 类别名称不能确定唯一机理。

biosynthesis.principle: An enzyme or cellular pathway transforms a precursor using biological cofactors and pathway context.
biosynthesis.principle_zh: 酶或细胞通路在生物辅因子和通路环境中转化前体。
typical_conditions: The reported enzyme/cell system, cofactors, expression context, and assay conditions
typical_conditions_zh: 文献报道的酶/细胞体系、辅因子、表达背景和测定条件
risk_notes: A net biosynthetic arrow may hide multiple enzymatic steps and unavailable intracellular intermediates.
risk_notes_zh: 净生物合成箭头可能隐藏多个酶促步骤和不可分离的细胞内中间体。
biosynthesis.evidence_boundary: Do not reinterpret a pathway-level transformation as a one-step chemical reaction.
biosynthesis.evidence_boundary_zh: 不得将通路级变换重新解释为一步化学反应。

literature_reaction.principle: The reaction was extracted from project literature, but its family label is not sufficiently specific for a named-reaction claim.
literature_reaction.principle_zh: 该反应来自项目文献抽取，但家族标签不足以支持命名反应结论。
typical_conditions: Read the cited source and extraction context before assigning conditions
typical_conditions_zh: 指定条件前必须阅读引用来源及抽取上下文
risk_notes: Extraction context, reagent parsing, and atom mapping require review.
risk_notes_zh: 抽取上下文、试剂解析和原子映射均需复核。
literature_reaction.evidence_boundary: Literature origin alone does not guarantee correct extraction or applicability to a new substrate.
literature_reaction.evidence_boundary_zh: 仅有文献来源不能保证抽取无误，也不能保证适用于新底物。
